name: Crescent Moon: The Truth of Feelings
source:
In the end of the world, a girl is kidnapped for her power which she doesn't know by herself. In the meantime, she finds something strange with her feeling when she meets her kidnapper. Will she know the truth of her feeling?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5412]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
世界末日之际，一名女孩因自己也不了解的力量遭人绑架。与绑匪相处时，她发现内心产生了一种异样的感情。她最终能否认清这份感情的真相？

[译自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5412]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
